description: Hostels in a city as listed on Hostelworld's public city page (up to 30, Hostelworld's own order): name, address, coordinates, guest rating out of 10 with review count, lowest 'from' price per night as shown (currency depends on the visitor region) and property URL. Needs the continent, country and city as in Hostelworld URLs (e.g. europe / germany / berlin). No live availability for dates. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City as in Hostelworld URLs, e.g. berlin, new-york, bangkok

continent.description: One of europe, asia, africa, north-america, south-america, oceania, central-america

country.description: Country as in Hostelworld URLs, e.g. germany, united-states, thailand
